env.akismet_method: Akismet 5.7.2 activated; no real API key is available, so wordpress_api_key was set to a fake value and a walk-only mu-plugin answered rest.akismet.com requests locally (and logged each call); removed afterwards

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.2.evidence: test_editor (space admin of Help Desk on this seed; WP role subscriber) replied in Help Desk topic 176 -> 201 publish (reply 1485), no Akismet call logged.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.3.evidence: test_moderator POST /posts/341/replies (Bug Reports) -> 201 publish (reply 1486), no Akismet call logged.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.4.evidence: test_moderator (WP editor holding the site Moderate capability, not a General Discussion space moderator) POST /spaces/15/posts -> 201 publish (topic 413) instantly, no Akismet call.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.5.evidence: ENV: needs a live Akismet API key so Akismet can classify the test string. With the local stub answering 'true' for it, bob's topic is saved with status 'spam' (topic 414, not public) - that shows Jetonomy's handling, not Akismet's classification.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.6.evidence: alice posts a normal reply on topic 176 -> 201 publish (1488) and the call log has exactly one comment-check for her.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.7.evidence: test_moderator (editor with Moderate capability, not a Help Desk space moderator) posted the spam test string as a reply in Help Desk -> 201 publish (1487) instantly, no Akismet call logged.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.8.evidence: Akismet deactivated: bob POST /spaces/15/posts -> 201 publish (416), no error; page loads without notice.

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.9.evidence: Stub made rest.akismet.com requests fail with 'cURL error 28: Operation timed out': bob's topic POST -> 201 publish (415), fails open, no fatal; no Jetonomy line in debug.log (only PMPro cron-schedule notices from the earlier PMPro activation).

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.10.evidence: `wp option get wordpress_api_key` was empty at the start: wp-admin Anti-Spam showed the no-key state (see .11). A fake non-empty key was then set to exercise the bypass path (a live key is not available; .5 stays ENV).

c-admin-akismet-staff-bypass.11.evidence: wp-admin Jetonomy Settings > Anti-Spam with Akismet active and no key: 'Akismet is active but has no API key, so new topics and replies are not checked for spam. Add an Akismet API key'; screenshot akismet-nokey.png.
